fr_aviation_noun.hook: A pioneer aviator in goggles sits in a red vintage biplane with a little AVIARY of songbirds strapped ON its wing: "AVIARY-ON!" (ah-vyah-SYOHN). Latin avis = bird: the early days of AVIATION.

fr_bond_noun.hook: A dog with a big BONE in its mouth leaps clean over the bench in one BOUND (BOHN).

fr_aeroport_noun.hook: A stork carries her bundle in her beak through the AIRPORT security arch: "AIR? OH... PORT!" (ah-ay-roh-POR)

fr_vol_noun.hook: A little VOLE scampers up the jet's boarding stairs, off on its first FLIGHT.
